# Mobile workspace refresh and ZIP security update (alpha)

This source release refreshes mobile document workspaces and readers, folder hubs,
search and appearance, and managed Local/LocalCrypt copy and mirror workflows.
It adds paired-iPhone deployment and opt-in TestFlight preparation with privacy
metadata and identity checks. Release publication still requires desktop checks,
Android/iOS native builds and both mobile runtime gates.

- Windows System Tools runs DISM, SFC, AppX re-registration and configured-drive
  CHKDSK directly in a separate administrator PowerShell console. The two repair
  batch files are removed; the console stays open for prompts and results.
- pyzipper is pinned to 0.4.0. New AES ZIP entries omit plaintext CRC32 checksums;
  existing archives are not rewritten. phue remains exactly pinned to 1.1.
- Desktop typography, themes, Git diff presentation and storage views are refined.
  Storage totals distinguish logical and allocated file sizes.
- The pinned commonUtils revision includes reusable native navigation and image
  components, while preserving the desktop native-dialog API.

Local validation: all 129 Logistics desktop test modules passed; 122 commonUtils
modules passed in the full run and the corrected native-component module passed
separately, including all four tests with the optional Toga backend. All 134 mobile
host tests and 35 Ally Tools tests passed. Go bridge tests, lint, release-tool tests
and all 24 historical/current archive compression comparisons passed. Both root
virtual environments were recreated from their respective updated lockfiles.

Local fixture checks do not replace physical-device or native Windows validation.
The source release does not itself upload an App Store or TestFlight binary.
